India Sees New Rules and Price Changes Effective July 1

Several significant rule changes and price adjustments came into effect across India on July 1, impacting daily life and household budgets. These changes affect various sectors including fuel, gas, vehicle regulations, and identification documents. While some adjustments offer relief, others are expected to increase expenses for citizens.
